SELECT COUNT(*) from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN
plancode = #{plancode} AND UNIT IN (SELECT ORGID FROM TBL_ORGANIZATION WHERE 1=1
and FATHERORGID in ( ${idsStr})
UNION ALL SELECT ${orgid} FROM DUAL)

SELECT '已评估' as name, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.riskid) as value from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t1 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t1.assplanid left join tbl_risk r1 on r1.RISKID=t1.RISKID where p.unit is not null and p.unit=#{company} and ( r1.riskstatus !=0 or r1.riskstatus is null) and planstatus =3 UNION ALL SELECT '评估中' as name, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.riskid) as value from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t2 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t2.assplanid left join tbl_risk r1 on r1.RISKID=t2.RISKID where p.unit is not null and p.unit=#{company} and ( r1.riskstatus !=0 or r1.riskstatus is null) and planstatus =2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t3 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t3.assplanid WHERE t3.riskid = t2.riskid AND p.planstatus =3 ) UNION ALL SELECT '未评估' as name, COUNT(DISTINCT t4.riskid) as value from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t4 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t4.assplanid left join tbl_risk r1 on r1.RISKID=t4.RISKID where p.unit is not null and p.unit=#{company} and ( r1.riskstatus !=0 or r1.riskstatus is null) and planstatus =1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t5 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t5.assplanid WHERE t5.riskid = t4.riskid AND p.planstatus IN (2, 3) )
